caption: 💌 Do not forget to SAVE for calm, stress-free snack  Share with a mama who needs peace today @bella.healthytinytummies @bella.healthytinytummies @bella.healthytinytummies Stop giving snacks that ruin toddlers' moods Pear & Apple Crumble Muffins are: These Naturally sweet & toddler-approved Soft, golden, comforting Made with real ingredients (no refined sugar) Ingredients (9 mini muffins): Fruits + Base: 1 small apple (~ 100 g), finely diced 1small pear (≈ 100 g),finely diced 1egg 1 tsp lemon juice 1/2 tsp cinnamon 1tsp honey (if baby>1yr) 2 tbsp plain yogurt Crumble Topping: 4 tbsp spelt or wheat flour (~ 40 g) 2 tbsp softened butter or neutral oil 1 tbsp coconut sugar or honey 1/2 tsp cinnamon Instructions: 1. Mix fruits + egg + yogurt+ cinnamon+ honey → soft, cohesive, not liquid. 2. Prepare crumble → sandy texture. 3. Fill muffin mold with fruit mixture → sprinkle crumble on top. 4.Bake: Oven: 180℃/ 15-18 min Air fryer:170°C/12-15 min 5. Goal: golden crumble, fruits soft and cohesive. Storage: Fridge: 5 days in an airtight container Freezer: 1 month → reheat 20 sec in microwave or 5 min in oven #pearapple #toddlersnacks #toddlerapproved  #autumnvibes #nosugaradded
